correctness.rationale: For any target, greedy embedding in each increasing permutation consumes one further period exactly at every adjacent weak descent. One-letter deletion changes that count by at most one, with explicit local change on triples. The endpoint conditions and all interior triple conditions are thus necessary and sufficient for exact minimal absence. Pair-overlap paths count each target exactly once; (I-M)p=Dw and vp=N hold identically as verified by integral polynomial arithmetic on 9 states/47 certificate terms. The fraction has D(0,0)=1. Direct tests independently matched 143310 literal strings over 12 host cases, and 1035 bounded coefficients agreed with the transfer polynomial identity. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This identifies the complete, all-length antichain spectrum for the first nonbinary repeated-permutation word family, replacing a general exponential-size statement by exact rational length-resolved counts and a local recognition criterion. The nine-state transfer has a reproducible finite polynomial certificate. Such structured repeated words are natural benchmarks for minimal-absent-subsequence enumeration, not arbitrary slices of an unrelated problem.
